"""task-9f35c8da: two corner bars; markers beam toward the bar sharing their row/col;

import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from lib import (background, components, bar_and_marker_colors, bar_segments,
                 beam, offset_fill)


def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bar, marker = bar_and_marker_colors(grid)
    segs = bar_segments(grid, bar)
    markers = [(r, c) for comp in components(grid, marker) for (r, c) in comp]

    offsets, aligned_idx = set(), set()
    for (r, c) in markers:
        for i, (horiz, fixed, lo, hi) in enumerate(segs):
            if horiz and lo <= c <= hi:
                offsets.add(c - lo)
                aligned_idx.add(i)
                beam(grid, (r, c), 1 if fixed > r else -1, 0, marker)
                break
            if not horiz and lo <= r <= hi:
                offsets.add(r - lo)
                aligned_idx.add(i)
                beam(grid, (r, c), 0, 1 if fixed > c else -1, marker)
                break
        else:
            raise ValueError("marker aligns with no bar")

    for r, c in markers:
        grid[r][c] = 4

    other = segs[[i for i in range(len(segs)) if i not in aligned_idx][0]]
    offset_fill(grid, other, offsets, marker)
    return grid
